title: Liapoldus HTTP runtime contract

routing.algorithm: Routes are examined in array order. A missing when is true. A true when selects then. A false when selects else when present, otherwise continues to the next route. default is used only when no route selected a terminal action; it must occur in the final route. A selected policy denial stops the pipeline.
routing.matcher: Sibling matcher fields are AND. all is AND, any is OR, not negates one matcher. A scalar string is exact except sourceIp, which is CIDR or IP. destinationPort accepts an integer, an inclusive N-M range, or integer list. sourceIp is the direct peer address; X-Forwarded-For never changes matching.
routing.transforms: request headers apply before auth; auth, WAF and rate limit run in this order; rewrite runs once before terminal; response headers merge site then route, with route set/delete winning; CORS, cache, then compression run after terminal.

proxy.host: The original request Host is preserved by default. proxy.host: upstream replaces it with selected target authority; a literal replaces it with that literal.
proxy.forwarded: Gateway appends the direct peer IP to X-Forwarded-For and overwrites X-Forwarded-Host, X-Forwarded-Proto and X-Forwarded-Port with the client-facing values. It removes incoming values of the latter three before setting them.
proxy.headers: Connection, Keep-Alive, Proxy-Authenticate, Proxy-Authorization, TE, Trailer, Transfer-Encoding and Upgrade are stripped except a WebSocket Upgrade negotiated by this route. Set-Cookie is forwarded unchanged. Trailer is not forwarded. HTTP/1.1 chunking is decoded/re-encoded as required; 100-continue is relayed only after the request passed policies.
proxy.websocket: Only a proxy route may upgrade WebSocket, after policies. HTTP/2 extended CONNECT is converted only for a negotiated WebSocket; all other hop-by-hop fields are never translated.

static.etag: "lpg-<revision>-<size-hex>-<mtime-unixns-hex>". It is strong only for an immutable release. If-None-Match has precedence over If-Modified-Since and produces 304 without a body.
static.range: Bytes ranges follow RFC 9110. A satisfiable single range returns 206 with Content-Range. Multiple ranges return multipart/byteranges. Unsatisfiable range returns 416 with Content-Range: bytes */<size>. If-Range mismatch returns the full 200 representation.
static.filesystem: Decoded path is normalized inside release root. NUL, absolute paths, traversal and symlinks escaping root return 404 route_not_found. Listings are disabled. A directory resolves only its configured index.

siteLocales: locales declares supported URL prefixes. /<locale>/x maps to release path /<locale>/x only for an exact declared locale. An unprefixed path maps to /<defaultLocale>/<path> when defaultLocale exists, without redirect. Accept-Language is ignored. No locale redirect is generated.

siteSources.release: Resolves the current immutable registry release. It supports publish and atomic rollback; site.yaml belongs to the active release root.
siteSources.directory: Uses a read-only local root and its site.yaml. Gateway does not watch the filesystem: a changed root or manifest needs validate/reload. File content is read per request. Publish, versions and rollback return 409 site_source_immutable.

cache: Gateway never stores response bodies. cache only emits Cache-Control for static responses and route responses. public/private require maxAge; no-store emits Cache-Control: no-store. Gateway appends Vary: Accept-Encoding only when compression is selected, Origin only when CORS reflects Origin, and never overwrites upstream Vary.
compression: Accept-Encoding q-values decide eligibility; q=0 excludes an encoding. Among equal q-values br wins over gzip. Responses below 1024 uncompressed body bytes, with existing Content-Encoding, no-transform, 1xx/204/304, Range, or Upgrade are not compressed. Selected compression emits Vary: Accept-Encoding.
cors: For an OPTIONS preflight with Origin and Access-Control-Request-Method matching configured CORS, Gateway returns 204 before terminal with Allow-Origin, Allow-Methods, Allow-Headers, optional Allow-Credentials and Max-Age. A non-matching origin does not emit CORS headers and proceeds normally.
